source_caption:
Horrible Bosses follows three friends—Nick, Dale, and Kurt—who are all stuck working under terrible bosses who make their lives miserable. Nick deals with a manipulative boss, played by Kevin Spacey, who dangles promotions without ever delivering. Dale is constantly harassed by his inappropriate boss, portrayed by Jennifer Aniston, while Kurt’s situation worsens when his kind boss dies and the company is taken over by the reckless son, played by Colin Farrell. Frustrated and desperate, the trio jokingly decide their lives would be better if their bosses were gone.

As their frustration grows, the friends actually attempt to carry out a ridiculous and poorly planned scheme to eliminate their bosses, seeking advice from a shady ex-con for guidance. What follows is a series of chaotic and comedic situations filled with misunderstandings, failed attempts, and unexpected twists. Despite their lack of criminal skills, their friendship and determination keep them going, leading to a wild and humorous conclusion that shows how far people might go when pushed to their limits.
